entities.summary: Cathedral Basilica of the Nativity of the Blessed Virgin Mary in Sandomierz is a gothic cathedral constructed in 1360. The cathedral was renovated in the baroque style in the 18th century, and first received the rank of cathedral in 1818. Sandomierz Cathedral is a minor basilica in Europe, established in 1361. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
